revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate for achievement_medal_travel_tier_004, later converted into a transparent 768x768 app asset
Primary request: Regenerate tier 4 as a clearly PURPLE rank travel medal for the Chinese title concept "游玩专家". This must read as purple at a glance in a six-medal sequence white, green, blue, purple, orange, gold. The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Input image role: the attached rank-medal screenshot is a reference for progressive border complexity only; do not copy its shield shape, numbers, dark UI, text, or exact design.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. Tier 4 has a circular medal plus exaggerated decoration: a dominant rich amethyst-purple enamel rim and purple inner ring, polished gold bevels, obvious symmetrical side wings, a crown-like top ornament, small lower pedestal flourish, and layered metal details. The purple areas must be large and unmistakable, more visible than gold or gray. Inside the circle is one compact funny center object: a cream-gold travel suitcase reclining lazily in one tiny first-class airplane seat, with one tiny drink cup as a comfort gag. The seat is readable but the suitcase remains dominant.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, refined and readable at small iOS size, playful but premium, crisp transparent-asset silhouette, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: base circular size consistent with a six-medal set; tier 4 outer decoration larger and more dramatic than blue tier but smaller and less fiery than orange tier; full medal visible, no cropping; centered symmetrical front view.
Lighting/mood: indulgent luxury, royal purple rank, glossy highlights, humorous vacation comfort.
Color palette: dominant amethyst purple and royal violet enamel, warm gold bevels, small silver highlights only, cream-gold suitcase, dark navy seat, tiny white drink cup, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: glossy purple enamel, polished purple-gold metal, plush seat, small glossy cup, beveled rim, lacquered toy surfaces, clean edges. No paper texture.
Text: none.
Constraints: one medal only; no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no map, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no camera, no neck pillow, no blanket, no airplane body, no window, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no shield badge, no black background, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
